# torchao has no stable release that works with PyTorch nightly, so CI installs
# this nightly from each job's PyTorch index:
#   pip install --pre -r .github/requirements-torchao.txt --index-url <index>
# Pick a date that every index CI uses serves (cu130, cu132, cpu, rocm10.0).
torchao==0.19.0.dev20261103
